summary: Two contract gaps: the Stokes-present path aborts instead of recording raw statistics, and 23 downloaded product labels lack ProductRecords. Required checks were not run under the read-only review restriction.

checks.criterion: AC1: Provider discovery, label-confirmed layout, zero-CPR handling, and tested io.py helpers
checks.evidence: pilot.py:2004-2036 follows the provider landing page to the volume and detached label. data/raw/minirf/lsz_xxxxx_3cp_piu_90s000_v1.lbl:48-91 states dimensions, sample type, special values, and projection. outputs/pilot/minirf_mosaic.json:235-319 records the lead comparisons. Synthetic parser/layout tests exist in test_io_pds3.py:154-676; test_pilot_minirf.py:825-848 asserts that zero CPR remains valid. Tests were inspected, not executed.

checks.criterion: AC2: Bounded range fetching, refusal of ignored Range requests, and saved HTTP metadata
checks.evidence: Execution was prohibited for this read-only review. Static evidence: io.py:533-537 rejects HTTP 200 before reading its body; pilot.py:2045-2094 saves successful rows or records the blocking limitation. data/raw/minirf/fetch.json:482-504 records HTTP 206, Content-Range, 5,628,224 received bytes, and retrieval time. Failure behavior was not exercised.

checks.criterion: AC3: Label-derived pyproj window conversion, dependency installation, and missing-extent fallback
checks.evidence: Projection execution was prohibited for this read-only review. pilot.py:1893-1906 and 2115-2151 implement conversion and the missing-extent reason; outputs/pilot/minirf_mosaic.json:921-959 records bounds and offsets. pyproj is declared at pipeline/pyproject.toml:13, locked in uv.lock, and installed metadata states version 3.8.0 at .venv/lib/python3.12/site-packages/pyproj-3.8.0.dist-info/METADATA:3.

checks.criterion: AC4: Required mosaic record fields and quality.py-based CPR statistics
checks.evidence: outputs/pilot/minirf_mosaic.json contains statistics at :2-24, label provenance at :201-216, layout and units at :218-234 and :906-908, null at :747-751, range metadata at :820-843, mixed look direction at :326-335, incidence limitation at :197-199, and handedness at :895-904. pilot.py:2780-2806 applies quality.validity_mask and preserves unavailable extrema as null. Numerical recomputation was not run.

checks.criterion: AC5: Discover Stokes coverage and record raw S1/S4 statistics when both layers exist
checks.evidence: The current no-S4 fallback is recorded at outputs/pilot/minirf_mosaic.json:879-881. However, pilot.py:2655-2661 unconditionally raises when any S4 layer exists. test_pilot_minirf.py:891-895 explicitly expects that error for a synthetic south-polar S4 layer alongside S1, instead of exercising the required raw statistics.

checks.criterion: AC6: ProductRecords for every product read, exact fetched-byte provenance, sorted upserts, and unreachable-source failure
checks.evidence: pilot.py:2025-2032 downloads every mosaic label and :2218 parses each one, but :2320-2353 creates records only for the selected CPR label and image rows. outputs/sources.json:2-43 contains only those two Mini-RF records, while outputs/pilot/minirf_mosaic.json:337-745 inventories 24 downloaded labels. Sorting and URL-naming failure paths are present, but were not executed.
User explicitly prohibited running checks in the read-only sandbox; test temporary files and caches require writes.

findings.claim: The required Stokes-present behavior is unimplemented. When S1 and S4 labels cover Site01, recording aborts instead of range-reading both layers and emitting the required raw statistics.
findings.evidence: fetch only reads CPR rows at pilot.py:2045-2047. _stokes_observation raises for every S4 label at :2655-2661 without considering coverage. test_pilot_minirf.py:891-895 supplies a south-polar S4 layer alongside S1 and requires PilotError, locking in behavior contrary to AC5.

resolution.reason: Fixed in eddb510 (tests in 4ba1c81; wording follow-up 7a49dc5). fetch now pairs each S4 layer covering Site01 with the one S1 layer on its grid (projection, size, look direction, START and STOP time). It range-reads the Site01 window rows of both in that grid, one request each, and stores them as <image>.img.rows. record decodes them with each label's layout and masks them with quality.validity_mask. stokes_observation (status observed) gives, per pair: layer file names, byte ranges, units, the count valid in both layers, the S4 > 0, < 0 and = 0 counts, and S1 and S4 min and max as stored. There is no verdict, no S1 and |S4| validity count and no minimum pixel count, and it names polarimetry.lunar_s4_sign_check (T2-05). The test that expected PilotError is replaced by tests for: the reads, the raw statistics against a bit-pattern oracle (positive, negative and zero S4), records for the rows, a second pair on the 512 pix/deg grid, an S4 layer outside Site01 (not read), and an S4 layer with no S1 partner (fetch stops before any read). Also: a refused Stokes range read (blocking limitation, recorded) and a fetch.json without the Stokes rows (refused). The real archive has no S4 layer, so the real record (1ef66eb) still says not_performed; its measured values are unchanged.

findings.claim: The source manifest omits ProductRecords for 23 other mosaic product labels that are downloaded and parsed, violating AC6's per-product provenance requirement.
findings.evidence: All label entries are parsed at pilot.py:2218, but record construction at :2320-2353 includes only the selected CPR label and rows. The committed mosaic inventory contains 24 labels at outputs/pilot/minirf_mosaic.json:337-745; outputs/sources.json:2-43 contains only two Mini-RF records. test_pilot_minirf.py:643-647 explicitly restricts the expected manifest to those two.

resolution.reason: Fixed in a61fae4 (tests in 7fffc64; the per-label fields were introduced in eddb510). Every mosaic label fetch downloads now gets a PARTIAL ProductRecord, with product_id MINIRF/LROMRF_0005/<label>, source_url, local_path and the sha256 of the label file. Its fields come from its own label (grid, CRS, units, times, special values), and qa_definition and the verification basis say whether its image was read. Image rows that were read keep their own record. The real record was re-fetched and re-recorded (1ef66eb): all 24 label records plus the CPR window rows, sorted by product_id. Every checksum equals the sha256 of its data/raw/minirf file, and the two existing CPR records are byte-identical. sources.json is 81,804 bytes, under the PRD 8.4 budget of 200 kB.
